audit.description: Changed production code imports and uses the real urllib3 API in en16931/b2brouter.py and en16931/validex.py, including urllib3.PoolManager and _HTTP.request calls for POST/GET operations. The unified diff removes requests imports and requests.post/get calls from the changed production files, and the static/dynamic evidence reports no production requests imports or source import attempts. The target origin is the installed site-packages urllib3 module and target_local_spec_count is 0, so the apparent target use is not a local fake provider.
evidence: en16931/b2brouter.py: import requests replaced by import urllib3; _HTTP = urllib3.PoolManager(cert_reqs=ssl.CERT_NONE); requests.post replaced with _HTTP.request('POST', ...).
en16931/validex.py: import requests replaced by import urllib3; _HTTP = urllib3.PoolManager(cert_reqs=ssl.CERT_NONE); requests.post/get replaced with _HTTP.request('POST'/'GET', ...).
setup.py: install_requires changed from requests to urllib3.
Static anti-cheat file checks for en16931/b2brouter.py and en16931/validex.py report imports_source=false, imports_target=true, fake_target_added_code=false, target_provider_added=false.

Dynamic anti-cheat metrics report source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0, target_events_from_production_repo_count=30, target_local_spec_count=0, and urllib3 origin under site-packages/urllib3/__init__.py.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses urllib3.PoolManager and request calls.
Changed production files no longer import or call requests.
Dynamic evidence shows target events from production repo code and zero source imports from repo code.
No local target provider or shim was detected.
